name: Tim Rogers
biography: Tim Rogers was born on September 20, 1969 in Australia. He is a composer and actor, known for Tomorrow, When the War Began (2010), Tracks (2013) and Idiot Box (1996). He has been married to Rocio Garcia Rodriguez since 1999.
